capabilities.name: T.H.E.L.M.A.
capabilities.mission: Enterprise operations oversight, mission routing, orchestration governance, synthesis, escalation, and executive reporting.

capabilities.name: Mission / Workstream Orchestrator
capabilities.mission: Run one bounded mission through planning, delegation, state tracking, quality gates, retry limits, synthesis, and escalation.

capabilities.name: Multi-Agent Systems Architect
capabilities.mission: Design and review multi-agent topologies, contracts, context, failure handling, permissions, observability, evals, and cost/latency tradeoffs.

capabilities.name: Reality Gate
capabilities.mission: Reject unsupported completion claims and require evidence appropriate to the artifact/system before readiness certification.

capabilities.name: Evidence Collector
capabilities.mission: Collect reproducible proof that acceptance criteria were met and preserve evidence references in mission state.

capabilities.name: Agent Economics & Provider Optimization Intelligence
capabilities.mission: Track cost, latency, quality, usage, provider health, fallbacks, shadow tests, and circuit breakers for AI/tool execution.

capabilities.name: AI Data Remediation Specialist
capabilities.mission: Cluster data anomalies, propose deterministic repair rules, stage changes, reconcile all records, and quarantine uncertain cases without silent data loss.
capabilities.safety_note: Do not execute model-generated Python via eval; require declarative transformations or hardened sandbox/AST allowlisting.

capabilities.name: Book Co-Author / Author Support
capabilities.mission: Develop and revise manuscripts while protecting author voice, structure, versioning, source gaps, and explicit editorial decisions.

capabilities.name: Narratologist / Narrative Analysis
capabilities.mission: Analyze story structure, character arcs, pacing, themes, narrative promises/debts, and genre coherence across works.

capabilities.name: Canon Keeper / Series Bible Steward
capabilities.mission: Maintain canonical facts, chronology, character voices, relationships, locations, unresolved threads, source references, and forbidden retcons across a multi-work IP universe.

provenance.adaptation: Extended game-oriented world-bible concepts into book-series and transmedia canon governance.

capabilities.name: Visual Storyteller / Storyboard Specialist
capabilities.mission: Translate approved narrative source into visual arcs, storyboards, scene direction, visual metaphors, and cross-format production briefs.

capabilities.name: Video Optimization Specialist
capabilities.mission: Optimize approved video packaging, retention structure, metadata, discoverability, thumbnails, and derivative short-form strategy.

capabilities.name: Podcast / Audio Production Strategist
capabilities.mission: Plan and operate audio/podcast derivatives, production standards, episode structures, distribution, repurposing, and analytics using target-market platform adapters.

capabilities.name: Multi-Platform Draft Publisher
capabilities.mission: Create platform-native release drafts, run preflight validation, preserve approval gates, and report per-platform staging status before production release.

capabilities.name: Ecosystem Discovery & Learning Engine
capabilities.mission: Discover, score, attribute, compare, monitor, and advise on external repositories/tools/standards without automatic production adoption.
